name: @lacspace/mail-providers
description: IMAP/SMTP server presets and MX-based provider detection for connecting mailboxes: Hostinger, Titan, GoDaddy, Google Workspace/Gmail, Microsoft 365/Outlook, Zoho, Yahoo and iCloud. providerFromMx() maps MX hosts to a provider, serverCandidates() returns ordered IMAP/SMTP settings to try (with imap./smtp./mail.<domain> fallbacks). Send limits are 'unknown' on purpose - apps set their own. No DNS calls, bring your own MX lookup. Zero dependencies, isomorphic.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
